blocks.en: Learn the complete eight-step staining procedure (inoculation, passage, fixation, staining, microscopy)

blocks.en: Understand the validation requirements and limitations of NAT methods as alternative methods

blocks.zh: 1.1 Indicator Cell Culture Method — 指示細胞培養法原理
blocks.en: 1.1 Indicator Cell Culture Method

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: 為什麼需要第二種方法？
blocks.en: Why is a second method needed?

blocks.zh: Section 0 介紹的培養法（Method A）需要 21–28 天，而且某些黴漿菌物種（特別是 M. hyorhinis）在傳統培養基上生長緩慢甚至不生長。指示細胞培養法（Method B）利用完全不同的原理 — 讓黴漿菌在活細胞上增殖，再用 DNA 螢光染色來檢測。
blocks.en: The culture method (Method A) introduced in Section 0 takes 21–28 days, and some mycoplasma species (especially M. hyorhinis) grow slowly or not at all on traditional media. The indicator cell culture method (Method B) works on a completely different principle — mycoplasma are allowed to multiply on living cells and are then detected by DNA fluorescent staining.

blocks.zh: 檢測原理：
blocks.en: Detection principle:

blocks.zh: DNA 螢光染劑（Bisbenzimide / Hoechst 33258）與所有 DNA 結合，包括細胞核 DNA、粒線體 DNA，以及黴漿菌 DNA
blocks.en: The DNA fluorescent dye (bisbenzimide / Hoechst 33258) binds to all DNA, including nuclear DNA, mitochondrial DNA and mycoplasma DNA

blocks.zh: 正常細胞：只看到細胞核的大型亮點和細胞質中的微小粒線體點
blocks.en: Normal cells: only large bright nuclei and tiny mitochondrial dots in the cytoplasm are seen

blocks.zh: 黴漿菌污染：在細胞表面和細胞間隙出現特徵性的顆粒狀或絲狀螢光 — 這是黴漿菌 DNA 的訊號
blocks.en: Mycoplasma contamination: characteristic particulate or filamentous fluorescence appears on the cell surface and in the intercellular spaces — this is the signal of mycoplasma DNA

blocks.zh: 粒線體 vs 黴漿菌的區分：粒線體螢光位於細胞質內部且分布相對均勻，而黴漿菌螢光出現在細胞膜表面或細胞間空間。有經驗的微生物學家能夠輕鬆區分兩者。
blocks.en: Distinguishing mitochondria from mycoplasma: Mitochondrial fluorescence is located inside the cytoplasm and is fairly evenly distributed, whereas mycoplasma fluorescence appears on the cell membrane surface or in the spaces between cells. An experienced microbiologist can readily tell the two apart.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 紫外光驗鈔：
blocks.en: Checking banknotes under UV light:

blocks.zh: 想像你在夜店門口用紫外光（UV black light）檢查入場者的手背蓋章。正常的蓋章（細胞核 DNA）會發出預期的大型亮光。但如果有人身上沾了不該有的螢光物質（黴漿菌 DNA），你會看到額外的、散布在皮膚表面的微小亮點 — 顆粒狀或絲狀。這些異常的螢光圖案就是「有不速之客」的證據。
blocks.en: Imagine you are checking the hand stamps of people entering a nightclub with a UV black light. A genuine stamp (nuclear DNA) gives off the expected large bright glow. But if someone has picked up a fluorescent substance they should not have (mycoplasma DNA), you will see extra tiny bright dots scattered over the skin surface — particulate or filamentous. These abnormal fluorescence patterns are the evidence of an "uninvited guest."

blocks.zh: 粒線體就像是你身上帶的螢光手錶 — 它也會在紫外光下發光，但因為它在手腕上（細胞質內部），位置和形態都與蓋章（黴漿菌）明顯不同。
blocks.en: Mitochondria are like a fluorescent watch you are wearing — it also glows under UV light, but because it sits on your wrist (inside the cytoplasm), its position and shape are clearly different from the stamp (mycoplasma).

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 病毒產品的特殊考量：如果待測樣品是病毒懸浮液，病毒可能造成明顯的細胞病變效應（CPE），干擾螢光判讀。USP ⟨63⟩ 提供兩個解決方案：(1) 使用特異性抗血清中和病毒，但必須證明該抗血清不會抑制黴漿菌；(2) 使用不支持病毒增殖的細胞株。
blocks.en: Special considerations for viral products: If the test sample is a virus suspension, the virus may cause obvious cytopathic effect (CPE) that interferes with the fluorescence reading. USP ⟨63⟩ offers two solutions: (1) neutralize the virus with a specific antiserum, but it must be shown that the antiserum does not inhibit mycoplasma; or (2) use a cell line that does not support virus propagation.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務影響：如果你的 CDMO 承接病毒載體（viral vector）生產或疫苗生產，這個考量尤其重要。你可能需要額外準備中和抗血清並驗證其對黴漿菌的無抑制性。
blocks.en: CDMO practical impact: This consideration is especially important if your CDMO undertakes viral vector or vaccine manufacturing. You may need to prepare neutralizing antiserum in addition and verify that it does not inhibit mycoplasma.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 在你的 CDMO 使用 AAV（腺相關病毒）載體生產基因治療產品時，指示細胞培養法會面臨什麼挑戰？你會如何解決 CPE 干擾的問題？
blocks.en: When your CDMO produces gene therapy products using AAV (adeno-associated virus) vectors, what challenges will the indicator cell culture method face? How would you solve the problem of CPE interference?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 USP ⟨63⟩ 要求在有抗血清和無抗血清條件下都進行正控測試？這個雙重設計的目的是什麼？
blocks.en: Why does USP ⟨63⟩ require positive control testing both with and without antiserum? What is the purpose of this dual design?

blocks.zh: 1.2 Verification of the Substrate — 基質驗證
blocks.en: 1.2 Verification of the Substrate

blocks.zh: 為什麼指定 Vero 細胞？
blocks.en: Why specify Vero cells?

blocks.zh: Vero 細胞（非洲綠猴腎細胞）是最廣泛使用的指示細胞株，因為它們：(1) 對多種黴漿菌物種敏感；(2) 貼壁生長，形成清晰的單層；(3) 容易在螢光顯微鏡下觀察
blocks.en: Vero cells (African green monkey kidney cells) are the most widely used indicator cell line because they: (1) are sensitive to many mycoplasma species; (2) grow adherently and form a clear monolayer; (3) are easy to observe under a fluorescence microscope

blocks.zh: USP 允許使用等效細胞培養（包括生產用細胞株本身），但必須驗證其檢測效能
blocks.en: USP allows the use of an equivalent cell culture (including the production cell line itself), but its detection performance must be verified

blocks.zh: 驗證用正控菌株的選擇邏輯：
blocks.en: Logic behind the choice of positive control strains for verification:

blocks.zh: M. hyorhinis — 是最常見的細胞培養污染源之一，但在傳統培養基上極難生長。這正是指示細胞法存在的核心理由
blocks.en: M. hyorhinis — one of the most common sources of cell culture contamination, yet extremely difficult to grow on traditional media. This is the core reason the indicator cell method exists

blocks.zh: M. orale — 人類口腔常見的黴漿菌，代表人員操作引入的污染風險
blocks.en: M. orale — a mycoplasma commonly found in the human oral cavity, representing the risk of contamination introduced by personnel handling

blocks.zh: 兩株都必須能被檢測到，否則基質驗證不通過
blocks.en: Both strains must be detected; otherwise the substrate verification fails

blocks.zh: 無抗生素傳代的要求：抗生素可能抑制黴漿菌（雖然大多數黴漿菌對beta-lactam抗生素耐藥，但某些抗生素如 gentamicin 可能有部分抑制效果），造成假陰性。測試前必須去除抗生素的殘留影響。
blocks.en: Requirement for passage without antibiotics: Antibiotics may inhibit mycoplasma (although most mycoplasma are resistant to beta-lactam antibiotics, some antibiotics such as gentamicin may have a partial inhibitory effect), causing false negatives. The residual effect of antibiotics must be removed before testing.

blocks.zh: 嗅探犬的資格認證：
blocks.en: Qualifying a sniffer dog:

blocks.zh: 指示細胞就像機場的嗅探犬。在正式執勤之前，你必須用已知的「樣品」（M. hyorhinis 和 M. orale）來測試這隻狗是否真的能聞出來。如果牠連低劑量（100 cfu）的標準品都找不到，那牠就不適合上場。此外，你不能讓嗅探犬在「被香水干擾」的環境下工作（抗生素殘留），否則牠的嗅覺判斷力會受影響。
blocks.en: Indicator cells are like the sniffer dogs at an airport. Before going on duty, you must test whether the dog can truly detect a known "sample" (M. hyorhinis and M. orale). If it cannot even find a low-level (100 cfu) reference standard, it is not fit for the job. Also, you cannot let the dog work in an environment "disturbed by perfume" (antibiotic residues), or its sense of smell will be impaired.

blocks.zh: 100 cfu/ccu 的意義：與培養法相同，驗證接種量設定在約 100 cfu/ccu，這代表一個相對低的挑戰量。如果指示細胞在這個低水準下都能檢測到黴漿菌，那在實際污染（通常高得多）時也能有效檢測。
blocks.en: Meaning of 100 cfu/ccu: As in the culture method, the verification inoculum is set at about 100 cfu/ccu, which represents a relatively low challenge. If the indicator cells can detect mycoplasma at this low level, they will also detect it effectively in real contamination (usually much higher).

blocks.zh: CDMO 細胞庫測試：對於生物製品 CDMO，在主細胞庫（MCB）和工作細胞庫（WCB）的黴漿菌放行測試中，指示細胞法是不可省略的。某些客戶甚至要求在生產結束（End-of-Production）細胞也進行此測試。
blocks.en: CDMO cell bank testing: For a biologics CDMO, the indicator cell method is indispensable in mycoplasma release testing of master cell banks (MCB) and working cell banks (WCB). Some clients even require this test on end-of-production cells.

blocks.zh: 如果你的 CDMO 的 QC 實驗室使用 CHO 細胞作為指示細胞（而非 Vero 細胞），你需要做哪些額外的驗證工作？
blocks.en: If your CDMO's QC laboratory uses CHO cells as indicator cells (instead of Vero cells), what additional validation work is required?

blocks.zh: 「無抗生素傳代」具體要傳幾代才算足夠？USP ⟨63⟩ 是否有明確規定？如果沒有，你會如何設計驗證方案？
blocks.en: How many passages without antibiotics are enough? Does USP ⟨63⟩ specify this explicitly? If not, how would you design the verification plan?

blocks.zh: 1.3 Test Method — 八步驟操作程序
blocks.en: 1.3 Test Method — Eight-Step Procedure

blocks.zh: 八步驟的關鍵控制點（Critical Control Points）：
blocks.en: Critical control points of the eight-step procedure:

blocks.zh: Step 1 — 接種密度控制：密度太高，3 天後過度融合，無法觀察；密度太低，細胞不夠健康，可能影響黴漿菌增殖
blocks.en: Step 1 — Inoculation density control: If the density is too high, the cells become over-confluent after 3 days and cannot be observed; if it is too low, the cells are not healthy enough, which may affect mycoplasma multiplication

blocks.zh: Step 2 — 50% 融合的要求：這是最關鍵的步驟之一。如果細胞達到完全融合（100%），細胞間的空間被填滿，你就無法看到黴漿菌在細胞表面和細胞間隙的螢光 — 相當於「證據被遮蓋了」
blocks.en: Step 2 — The 50% confluence requirement: This is one of the most critical steps. If the cells reach full confluence (100%), the spaces between cells are filled and you cannot see the fluorescence of mycoplasma on the cell surface and in the intercellular spaces — the equivalent of "covering up the evidence"

blocks.zh: Step 3 — 固定液比例：冰醋酸:甲醇 = 1:3（Carnoy's fixative 的變體），必須現配現用
blocks.en: Step 3 — Fixative ratio: Glacial acetic acid:methanol = 1:3 (a variant of Carnoy's fixative), which must be prepared fresh

blocks.zh: Step 4 — 乾燥風險：如果玻片乾燥後再染色，可能產生偽影（artifacts），導致假陽性判讀
blocks.en: Step 4 — Risk of drying: If slides are allowed to dry before staining, artifacts may appear and lead to false positive readings

blocks.zh: Step 7 — 螢光顯微鏡參數：330–380 nm 激發光 + LP 440 nm 阻擋濾光片是 Hoechst 33258（bisbenzimide）的標準光學設定
blocks.en: Step 7 — Fluorescence microscope settings: 330–380 nm excitation + LP 440 nm barrier filter is the standard optical setup for Hoechst 33258 (bisbenzimide)

blocks.zh: Step 8 — 多視野觀察：不能只看一個視野就下結論，必須按照驗證建立的方案檢查多個顯微鏡視野
blocks.en: Step 8 — Multiple fields of view: You cannot draw a conclusion from a single field; multiple microscope fields must be examined according to the protocol established during validation

blocks.zh: 犯罪現場鑑識的 UV 搜索：
blocks.en: UV search at a crime scene investigation:

blocks.zh: 整個八步驟程序就像是 CSI 犯罪現場調查的流程。Step 1-2 是「佈線現場」（準備指示細胞基質）；Step 3-4 是「保全證據」（固定和清洗，避免證據被破壞）；Step 5-6 是「噴灑魯米諾（Luminol）」（DNA 染色）；Step 7-8 是「用紫外光搜索」（螢光顯微鏡觀察）。
blocks.en: The whole eight-step procedure is like a CSI crime scene investigation. Steps 1–2 are "setting up the scene" (preparing the indicator cell substrate); Steps 3–4 are "preserving the evidence" (fixation and washing, so the evidence is not destroyed); Steps 5–6 are "spraying luminol" (DNA staining); Steps 7–8 are "searching with UV light" (fluorescence microscopy).

blocks.zh: 50% 融合的要求就像是犯罪現場不能太擁擠 — 如果地板上堆滿了家具（過度融合的細胞），你就看不到血跡（黴漿菌螢光）了。
blocks.en: The 50% confluence requirement is like saying the crime scene must not be too crowded — if the floor is piled with furniture (over-confluent cells), you cannot see the bloodstains (mycoplasma fluorescence).

blocks.zh: Bisbenzimide 的保存要求：母液必須避光保存（光敏感性染劑），工作液必須臨用現配。這在 QC 實驗室的 SOP 中必須明確規定，並在培訓中強調。
blocks.en: Storage requirements for bisbenzimide: The stock solution must be protected from light (a light-sensitive dye), and the working solution must be prepared immediately before use. This must be stated explicitly in the QC laboratory SOP and emphasized in training.

blocks.zh: 固定液的時效性：冰醋酸/甲醇固定液必須新鮮配製。使用舊的固定液可能導致固定不完全，影響染色品質和判讀準確性。
blocks.en: Shelf life of the fixative: The glacial acetic acid/methanol fixative must be freshly prepared. Using old fixative may lead to incomplete fixation, affecting staining quality and the accuracy of interpretation.

blocks.zh: 驗證的核心角色：注意 Step 8 提到「according to the protocol established during validation」— 這意味著你的 QC 實驗室必須在方法驗證階段就建立明確的視野數量、觀察標準和判讀準則。這不是隨意看幾個視野就能決定的。
blocks.en: The central role of validation: Note that Step 8 refers to "according to the protocol established during validation" — this means your QC laboratory must establish the number of fields, the observation criteria and the interpretation criteria clearly at the method validation stage. This cannot be decided by simply looking at a few random fields.

blocks.zh: 如果你的 QC 分析人員在 Step 2 未能控制好細胞密度，細胞達到了 90% 融合，你會直接進行染色判讀還是重做？為什麼？
blocks.en: If your QC analyst fails to control cell density in Step 2 and the cells reach 90% confluence, would you proceed directly to staining and reading, or repeat the test? Why?

blocks.zh: Step 4 提到玻片乾燥後染色可能產生偽影。在你的 SOP 中，你會如何設計「從固定到染色的時間窗口」來避免這個問題？
blocks.en: Step 4 notes that slides drying before staining can produce artifacts. How would you design the time window from fixation to staining in your SOP to avoid this problem?

blocks.zh: 你的 QC 實驗室需要驗證每張玻片至少觀察多少個顯微鏡視野？你會如何設計這個驗證方案？
blocks.en: What is the minimum number of microscope fields per slide that your QC laboratory needs to validate? How would you design this validation plan?

blocks.zh: 1.4 Solutions Reference — 試劑溶液參考
blocks.en: 1.4 Solutions Reference

blocks.zh: Bisbenzimide（Hoechst 33258）的稀釋倍數：
blocks.en: Dilution factors for bisbenzimide (Hoechst 33258):

blocks.zh: 母液濃度：5 mg / 100 mL = 50 µg/mL
blocks.en: Stock solution concentration: 5 mg / 100 mL = 50 µg/mL

blocks.zh: 工作液：100 µL 母液 / 100 mL = 0.05 µg/mL（1,000 倍稀釋）
blocks.en: Working solution: 100 µL stock / 100 mL = 0.05 µg/mL (a 1,000-fold dilution)

blocks.zh: 這個極低的工作濃度足以與 DNA 結合產生螢光，但不會造成過強的背景螢光
blocks.en: This very low working concentration is enough to bind DNA and produce fluorescence without causing excessive background fluorescence

blocks.zh: 固定液的科學：
blocks.en: The science of the fixative:

blocks.zh: 甲醇：使蛋白質變性並脫水固定細胞，同時保持 DNA 可被染色
blocks.en: Methanol: denatures proteins and dehydrates and fixes the cells, while keeping the DNA stainable

blocks.zh: 冰醋酸：幫助去除組蛋白（histones），使 DNA 更容易與染劑結合
blocks.en: Glacial acetic acid: helps remove histones, making it easier for the DNA to bind the dye

blocks.zh: 1:3 的比例是經過驗證的最佳平衡 — 足以固定但不破壞 DNA 結構
blocks.en: The 1:3 ratio is a validated optimum — enough to fix without damaging the DNA structure

blocks.zh: 攝影的曝光設定：
blocks.en: Exposure settings in photography:

blocks.zh: 螢光顯微鏡的參數設定就像相機的曝光設定。激發濾光片（330–380 nm）像是選擇正確的閃光燈波長，阻擋濾光片（LP 440 nm）像是設定只讓特定顏色的光進入鏡頭，放大倍率（400×）像是選擇正確的鏡頭焦距。每一個參數都不能隨意更改 — 就像你不能用紅光去拍需要紫外光才能顯現的證據一樣。
blocks.en: Setting up a fluorescence microscope is like setting the exposure on a camera. The excitation filter (330–380 nm) is like choosing the right flash wavelength, the barrier filter (LP 440 nm) is like setting which colors of light are allowed into the lens, and the magnification (400×) is like choosing the right focal length. No parameter may be changed arbitrarily — just as you cannot use red light to photograph evidence that only shows up under UV light.

blocks.zh: QC 實驗室的試劑管理：bisbenzimide 母液的避光保存是關鍵。建議使用棕色或鋁箔包裹的容器，並記錄開封日期和有效期限。工作液的「臨用現配」要求意味著不能提前批量配製。
blocks.en: Reagent management in the QC laboratory: Protecting the bisbenzimide stock solution from light is critical. Brown containers or containers wrapped in aluminum foil are recommended, and the opening date and expiry date should be recorded. The requirement to prepare the working solution immediately before use means it cannot be prepared in bulk in advance.

blocks.zh: 設備確認（IQ/OQ/PQ）：螢光顯微鏡必須經過適當的設備確認，包括濾光片的光譜特性驗證、光源強度的定期校準。這些是 GMP 環境下設備管理的基本要求。
blocks.en: Equipment qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ): The fluorescence microscope must undergo appropriate equipment qualification, including verification of the spectral characteristics of the filters and periodic calibration of light source intensity. These are basic requirements for equipment management in a GMP environment.

blocks.zh: 如果你的 QC 實驗室的螢光顯微鏡光源開始老化（強度下降），這會如何影響黴漿菌的檢測結果？你的預防性維護計畫中應包含什麼？
blocks.en: If the light source of your QC laboratory's fluorescence microscope begins to age (declining intensity), how would this affect mycoplasma detection results? What should your preventive maintenance plan include?

blocks.zh: bisbenzimide 工作液的「臨用現配」要求在高通量測試環境中可能造成效率問題。你有什麼解決方案？
blocks.en: The requirement to prepare the bisbenzimide working solution immediately before use may cause efficiency problems in a high-throughput testing environment. What solutions do you have?

blocks.zh: 1.5 Interpretation of Results — 結果判讀
blocks.en: 1.5 Interpretation of Results

blocks.zh: 判讀邏輯與培養法完全一致：
blocks.en: The interpretation logic is identical to the culture method:

blocks.zh: 正控必須陽性 — 如果正控（接種了已知黴漿菌的指示細胞）看不到典型螢光，代表系統失敗（可能是染色問題、顯微鏡問題、細胞問題，或菌株問題），整個測試無效
blocks.en: The positive control must be positive — if the positive control (indicator cells inoculated with a known mycoplasma) does not show typical fluorescence, the system has failed (possibly a staining problem, microscope problem, cell problem or strain problem) and the entire test is invalid

blocks.zh: 負控必須陰性 — 如果負控（未接種的指示細胞）出現典型螢光，代表實驗室環境有交叉污染，整個測試無效
blocks.en: The negative control must be negative — if the negative control (uninoculated indicator cells) shows typical fluorescence, there is cross-contamination in the laboratory environment and the entire test is invalid

blocks.zh: 只有在正控和負控都通過的情況下，檢品結果才有意義
blocks.en: Only when both the positive and negative controls pass is the test article result meaningful

blocks.zh: 「典型螢光」的判斷標準：
blocks.en: Criteria for "typical fluorescence":

blocks.zh: 黴漿菌陽性：細胞表面出現顆粒狀（pinpoints）或絲狀（filaments）的核外螢光，可能延伸至細胞間隙
blocks.en: Mycoplasma positive: extranuclear fluorescence in the form of pinpoints or filaments on the cell surface, which may extend into the intercellular spaces

blocks.zh: 非黴漿菌：細胞核的大型均勻亮斑、細胞質內散布的粒線體微點（位於細胞內部，不在表面）
blocks.en: Not mycoplasma: large uniform bright nuclei, and scattered mitochondrial dots in the cytoplasm (inside the cell, not on the surface)

blocks.zh: 三個交通信號燈：
blocks.en: Three traffic lights:

blocks.zh: 想像一個有三個信號燈的十字路口：
blocks.en: Imagine an intersection with three traffic lights:

blocks.zh: 正控信號燈（綠燈 = 有螢光）：必須亮起，證明信號系統正常運作
blocks.en: Positive control light (green = fluorescence): must light up, proving the signal system works properly

blocks.zh: 負控信號燈（紅燈 = 無螢光）：必須保持不亮，證明沒有誤觸發
blocks.en: Negative control light (red = no fluorescence): must stay off, proving there is no false triggering

blocks.zh: 只有當這兩個信號燈都正常，你才能相信檢品信號燈的結果 — 不亮就是通過，亮了就是有問題
blocks.en: Only when both lights are normal can you trust the result of the test article light — off means pass, on means a problem

blocks.zh: 如果正控信號燈不亮（系統壞了）或負控信號燈亮了（有干擾），你根本不能信任任何信號。整個系統必須重新啟動（重做測試）。
blocks.en: If the positive control light does not come on (the system is broken) or the negative control light comes on (there is interference), you cannot trust any signal at all. The whole system must be restarted (repeat the test).

blocks.zh: 在你的 QC 報告中，如果指示細胞法結果為「疑似陽性」（螢光圖案不典型，介於粒線體和黴漿菌之間），你的處理程序應該是什麼？
blocks.en: In your QC report, if the indicator cell method result is "suspected positive" (an atypical fluorescence pattern, between mitochondrial and mycoplasma), what should your procedure be?

blocks.zh: 如果培養法 (A) 結果為陰性但指示細胞法 (B) 結果為陽性，產品是否合格？你會如何處理這種不一致的結果？
blocks.en: If the culture method (A) result is negative but the indicator cell method (B) result is positive, does the product pass? How would you handle such a discrepancy?

blocks.zh: 從 CDMO 商業角度考量，指示細胞法需要 6–10 天 vs 培養法需要 28 天。在產品放行的時間壓力下，你會如何設計測試排程？
blocks.en: From a CDMO commercial perspective, the indicator cell method takes 6–10 days vs 28 days for the culture method. Under time pressure for product release, how would you design the testing schedule?

blocks.zh: 指示細胞法 vs 培養法的互補性：
blocks.en: Complementarity of the indicator cell method and the culture method:

blocks.zh: 兩種方法的結合才能提供完整的黴漿菌檢測覆蓋率，這是 USP ⟨63⟩ 要求同時使用兩種方法的根本原因。
blocks.en: Only the combination of the two methods provides complete coverage for mycoplasma detection, which is the fundamental reason USP ⟨63⟩ requires both methods to be used

blocks.zh: 1.6 NAT-Based Alternative Methods — 核酸擴增替代方法
blocks.en: 1.6 NAT-Based Alternative Methods

blocks.zh: USP ⟨63⟩ 對替代方法的立場：
blocks.en: USP ⟨63⟩ position on alternative methods:

blocks.zh: 允許使用，但有嚴格前提：必須與培養法 (A) 和指示細胞法 (B) 兩者都具有可比較性
blocks.en: Permitted, but with a strict precondition: the method must be comparable to both the culture method (A) and the indicator cell method (B)

blocks.zh: 驗證要求在本章中「不予討論」— 意味著實驗室必須參考其他法規指引（如 EP 2.6.7、PDA TR 50、FDA guidance）來設計驗證方案
blocks.en: Validation requirements are "not discussed" in this chapter — meaning laboratories must refer to other regulatory guidance (such as EP 2.6.7, PDA TR 50, FDA guidance) to design the validation plan

blocks.zh: 這段文字出現在「導論」中（Section 0 也有涵蓋），但其實際意義對整個章節架構至關重要
blocks.en: This passage appears in the "Introduction" (also covered in Section 0), but its practical significance is critical to the structure of the whole chapter

blocks.zh: 常見的替代方法類型：
blocks.en: Common types of alternative methods:

blocks.zh: PCR / qPCR — 擴增黴漿菌特異性基因片段（如 16S rRNA），最常用的 NAT 方法
blocks.en: PCR / qPCR — amplifies mycoplasma-specific gene fragments (such as 16S rRNA); the most commonly used NAT method

blocks.zh: MycoAlert™ 等酶活性方法 — 檢測黴漿菌特有的酶活性（如腺苷酸激酶），快速（~20 分鐘）但靈敏度可能較低
blocks.en: Enzyme activity methods such as MycoAlert™ — detect enzyme activities specific to mycoplasma (such as adenylate kinase); fast (~20 minutes) but possibly less sensitive

blocks.zh: LAMP（環介導等溫擴增） — 不需要 PCR 熱循環儀，操作更簡便
blocks.en: LAMP (loop-mediated isothermal amplification) — does not require a PCR thermal cycler and is simpler to operate

blocks.zh: 新型安檢設備的認證：
blocks.en: Certifying a new security scanner:

blocks.zh: 想像機場安檢有兩道標準程序：X 光掃描（培養法）和人工搜身（指示細胞法）。現在有人開發了一台新型全身掃描儀（NAT/PCR 方法），聲稱可以替代舊方法。USP ⟨63⟩ 說：「可以用，但你必須證明這台新機器能找到 X 光和搜身兩者都能找到的東西。」而且，「怎麼做這個比較驗證？我們不在這裡教你 — 去看另一本手冊。」
blocks.en: Imagine airport security has two standard procedures: X-ray scanning (the culture method) and a manual pat-down (the indicator cell method). Now someone has developed a new full-body scanner (the NAT/PCR method) and claims it can replace the old methods. USP ⟨63⟩ says: "You may use it, but you must prove that the new machine can find everything that both the X-ray and the pat-down can find." And as for "how to do this comparability validation? We will not teach you here — go and look at another manual."

blocks.zh: NAT 方法的巨大時間優勢：PCR/qPCR 方法可在數小時內出結果，相比培養法的 28 天和指示細胞法的 6–10 天，這對產品放行速度有革命性的影響。然而，速度優勢必須建立在嚴格驗證的基礎上。
blocks.en: The huge time advantage of NAT methods: PCR/qPCR methods can give results within hours, compared with 28 days for the culture method and 6–10 days for the indicator cell method, which has a revolutionary effect on the speed of product release. However, the speed advantage must rest on rigorous validation.

blocks.zh: 「comparable to both」的高門檻：注意 USP ⟨63⟩ 要求與「兩種方法都」具有可比較性，不是只與其中一種。這意味著 NAT 方法必須能檢測到培養法能長出的物種以及指示細胞法能檢測到的物種（如培養困難的 M. hyorhinis）。
blocks.en: The high bar of "comparable to both": Note that USP ⟨63⟩ requires comparability with "both methods," not just one. This means the NAT method must be able to detect the species that grow in the culture method and the species detected by the indicator cell method (such as the hard-to-culture M. hyorhinis).

blocks.zh: CDMO 的策略考量：許多先進 CDMO 已經採用 NAT 作為過程中檢測（in-process testing）的快速篩選工具，同時保留傳統方法作為放行測試（release testing）的法定方法。這種「雙軌制」兼顧了速度和合規性。
blocks.en: Strategic considerations for CDMOs: Many advanced CDMOs already use NAT as a rapid screening tool for in-process testing, while retaining the traditional methods as the compendial methods for release testing. This "dual-track" approach balances speed and compliance.

blocks.zh: 你的客戶要求使用 PCR 方法取代傳統的 28 天培養法來加速細胞庫放行。你會如何向客戶解釋 USP ⟨63⟩ 的要求和挑戰？
blocks.en: Your client asks you to use a PCR method in place of the traditional 28-day culture method to speed up cell bank release. How would you explain the requirements and challenges of USP ⟨63⟩ to the client?

blocks.zh: NAT 方法能檢測死菌 DNA（因為它偵測的是核酸而非活菌生長）。這在什麼情況下可能造成「假陽性」？對你的測試結果判讀有什麼影響？
blocks.en: NAT methods can detect DNA from dead organisms (because they detect nucleic acid rather than viable growth). Under what circumstances could this cause a "false positive"? What is the effect on how you interpret your test results?

blocks.zh: 設計一個「雙軌制」測試策略：NAT 用於快速過程中篩選，傳統方法用於最終放行。畫出時間線，說明這如何加速你的 CDMO 產品放行流程。
blocks.en: Design a "dual-track" testing strategy: NAT for rapid in-process screening, traditional methods for final release. Draw the timeline and explain how this accelerates product release at your CDMO.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 指示細胞培養法（Method B）利用 DNA 螢光染色（Hoechst 33258 / bisbenzimide）檢測黴漿菌在活細胞表面的特徵性螢光模式 — 顆粒狀或絲狀核外螢光
blocks.en: The indicator cell culture method (Method B) uses DNA fluorescent staining (Hoechst 33258 / bisbenzimide) to detect the characteristic fluorescence pattern of mycoplasma on the surface of living cells — particulate or filamentous extranuclear fluorescence

blocks.zh: Vero 細胞是標準指示細胞株，必須通過 M. hyorhinis 和 M. orale 的效能驗證；測試前必須在無抗生素條件下傳代
blocks.en: Vero cells are the standard indicator cell line and must pass performance verification with M. hyorhinis and M. orale; they must be passaged without antibiotics before testing

blocks.zh: 八步驟操作程序中的關鍵控制點：50% 融合度控制（避免過度融合遮蔽螢光）、固定液現配現用、染色時間控制、多視野觀察
blocks.en: Critical control points in the eight-step procedure: control of 50% confluence (to avoid over-confluence masking the fluorescence), freshly prepared fixative, control of staining time, and examination of multiple fields

blocks.zh: 結果判讀與培養法一致：正控必須有典型螢光、負控必須無典型螢光，否則測試無效
blocks.en: Result interpretation is consistent with the culture method: the positive control must show typical fluorescence and the negative control must not, otherwise the test is invalid

blocks.zh: Method B 的核心價值在於能檢測培養基上不易生長的物種（如 M. hyorhinis），與 Method A 互補
blocks.en: The core value of Method B is its ability to detect species that grow poorly on culture media (such as M. hyorhinis), complementing Method A

blocks.zh: NAT（如 PCR）替代方法可使用，但必須驗證與 Method A 和 Method B 兩者的可比較性 — 驗證細節不在本章範圍內
blocks.en: NAT (such as PCR) alternative methods may be used, but comparability with both Method A and Method B must be demonstrated — the validation details are outside the scope of this chapter

blocks.zh: CDMO 最佳實務：採用「雙軌制」— NAT 快速篩選（數小時）+ 傳統方法最終放行（28 天），兼顧速度與合規性
blocks.en: CDMO best practice: adopt a "dual-track" approach — NAT rapid screening (hours) + traditional methods for final release (28 days), balancing speed and compliance
